title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
prompt:
Return the level-order traversal of a binary tree: a list of levels, each level a list of values left-to-right.

**Example**: `[3,9,20,null,null,15,7]` → `[[3],[9,20],[15,7]]`.

The BFS template with the frozen-size trick.
hints: Null root → return the empty list immediately (never offer null to the queue).
`int size = q.size();` BEFORE the inner loop — the queue grows while you process the level.

solution.explanation: O(n). The snapshot `size` separates generations: exactly the nodes present at the top of the while-loop belong to the current level, no matter how many children get offered meanwhile.
